entries.en: She changed the labels to Arial so they would match the rest of the poster.
entries.zh: 她把标签字体改成Arial，使其与海报其余部分保持一致。

entries.meaningZh: -an；构成表示某人、地方或时期相关的名词或形容词
entries.en: In Shakespearean, the suffix -an indicates a connection with Shakespeare.
entries.zh: 在Shakespearean中，后缀-an表示与莎士比亚有关。

entries.meaningZh: -cy；构成表示状态、性质或职位的名词
entries.en: The suffix -cy in captaincy turns the title captain into the name of a position.
entries.zh: captaincy中的后缀-cy使captain这一称号变为表示职位的名词。

entries.meaningZh: -ency；构成表示状态或性质的名词
entries.en: The spelling exercise pairs dependent with dependency to illustrate the ending -ency.
entries.zh: 拼写练习将dependent与dependency配对，以说明-ency这一词尾。

entries.en: The ending -faced in red-faced describes the person's appearance.
entries.zh: red-faced中的-faced描述一个人的面容。

entries.en: In cardiogram, -gram refers to a recorded tracing.
entries.zh: 在cardiogram中，-gram表示记录下来的描记图。

entries.meaningZh: -ier；构成某些表示从事某种活动的人的名词
entries.en: The ending -ier in bombardier identifies a person associated with a particular activity.
entries.zh: bombardier中的词尾-ier表示从事某种特定活动的人。

entries.meaningZh: -ise；构成动词的词尾，部分词中为-ize的拼写变体
entries.en: The editor uses -ise in organise throughout the British edition.
entries.zh: 编辑在整个英式版本中都采用organise这一带-ise词尾的拼写。

entries.meaningZh: -ist；表示从事某种活动或信奉某种思想的人
entries.en: The suffix -ist turns violin into violinist, a person who plays the violin.
entries.zh: 后缀-ist把violin变为violinist，表示拉小提琴的人。

entries.en: The label uses the ending -leaved in the description broad-leaved.
entries.zh: 标签在broad-leaved这一描述中使用了-leaved，表示叶子的特征。

entries.meaningZh: -logical；构成与某学科或研究有关的形容词
entries.en: In geological, the ending -logical helps form an adjective relating to geology.
entries.zh: 在geological中，词尾-logical参与构成表示与地质学有关的形容词。

entries.meaningZh: -ly；常用于构成表示方式的副词
entries.en: Adding -ly to careful gives carefully.
entries.zh: 在careful后加上-ly便得到carefully，表示“小心地”。

entries.en: The suffix -most makes outermost refer to the furthest position on the outside.
entries.zh: 后缀-most使outermost表示处在最外层的位置。

entries.meaningZh: -ological；构成与某学科或研究有关的形容词
entries.en: The word sociological uses the ending -ological to express a relation to sociology.
entries.zh: sociological一词用-ological这一词尾表示与社会学有关。

entries.en: The ending -phile in bibliophile identifies someone who loves books.
entries.zh: bibliophile中的-phile表示喜爱书籍的人。

entries.meaningZh: -phobic；表示对某事物恐惧或排斥的
entries.en: In claustrophobic, the ending -phobic expresses fear associated with enclosed spaces.
entries.zh: 在claustrophobic中，-phobic表示与封闭空间有关的恐惧。

entries.meaningZh: -speak；表示某群体或领域特有的说话方式
entries.en: The reviewer uses -speak in technospeak to suggest specialised technical language.
entries.zh: 评论者在technospeak一词中用-speak表示专门的技术语言。

entries.meaningZh: -th；构成某些表示状态、性质或度量的名词
entries.en: In width, the ending -th helps form the noun corresponding to wide.
entries.zh: 在width中，词尾-th参与构成与wide相对应的名词。

entries.en: The ending -worthy in trustworthy suggests deserving someone's trust.
entries.zh: trustworthy中的-worthy表示值得信任。

entries.meaningZh: Anglo-；表示英国或英语相关的
entries.en: The heading Anglo-French describes a connection between Britain and France.
entries.zh: 标题中的Anglo-French表示英国与法国之间的联系。

entries.meaningZh: B.O.；体味，通常指令人不适的汗味
entries.en: He washed his gym shirt because it smelled of B.O.
entries.zh: 他把运动衫洗了，因为衣服上有汗臭味。

entries.en: The letter was addressed to Col. Harris.
entries.zh: 这封信是写给哈里斯上校的。

entries.en: The exhibition closes on 18 Dec.
entries.zh: 展览于12月18日结束。

entries.meaningZh: Hons；荣誉学位的标记，honours的缩写
entries.en: Her certificate records the qualification as BA (Hons).
entries.zh: 她的证书将该学历记为荣誉文学学士。

entries.en: The archive lists the audio file's bit rate in Kbps.
entries.zh: 档案以千比特每秒列出这份音频文件的比特率。

entries.meaningZh: MRSA；耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌
entries.en: The textbook expands MRSA at the start of the chapter.
entries.zh: 教科书在本章开头写出了MRSA的全称。

entries.en: Please send the completed form to the PO Box printed below.
entries.zh: 请把填好的表格寄往下方印出的邮政信箱。

entries.en: The old chart uses R.E. for the right eye.
entries.zh: 这张旧记录表用R.E.表示右眼。

entries.meaningZh: SASE；附有地址并贴好邮票的回邮信封
entries.en: The magazine asked contributors to include a SASE with their manuscripts.
entries.zh: 杂志要求投稿人在稿件中附上写好地址并贴足邮票的回邮信封。

entries.en: The course begins on 9 Sept.
entries.zh: 这门课程于9月9日开始。

entries.meaningZh: TESL；把英语作为第二语言的教学
entries.en: Her TESL course included supervised classroom practice.
entries.zh: 她的英语作为第二语言教学课程包括有指导的课堂实践。

entries.meaningZh: USP；独特卖点，unique selling proposition的缩写
entries.en: The shop's USP is its range of locally made notebooks.
entries.zh: 这家店的独特卖点是它出售的各式本地制作笔记本。

entries.en: It's a crying shame to leave such a beautiful building empty.
entries.zh: 让这么漂亮的建筑空置着，真是太可惜了。

entries.en: In asymmetrical, the prefix a- indicates the absence of symmetry.
entries.zh: 在asymmetrical中，前缀a-表示缺乏对称性。

entries.en: The prefix agro- connects agroforestry with agriculture.
entries.zh: 前缀agro-将agroforestry一词与农业联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 以及其他方面；以及别的方式
entries.en: The move was costly, financially and otherwise.
entries.zh: 这次搬家在经济上和其他方面都代价不小。

entries.en: The prefix anti- in antiwar expresses opposition to war.
entries.zh: antiwar中的前缀anti-表示反对战争。

entries.meaningZh: 尽可能好地；尽力地（用于 as best one can 等结构）
entries.en: She repaired the torn map as best she could with the materials available.
entries.zh: 她用手头的材料尽力修补了那张撕破的地图。

entries.en: The prefix astro- points to the study of celestial objects in astrophysics.
entries.zh: astrophysics中的前缀astro-指向对天体的研究。

entries.en: She checked her bank balance before paying the rent.
entries.zh: 她在付房租前查了一下银行账户余额。

entries.meaningZh: 极度紧张而难以应付事情的人（非正式用语）
entries.en: The thought of speaking in front of everyone turned me into a basket case.
entries.zh: 一想到要在所有人面前发言，我就紧张得不知所措。

entries.meaningZh: BBD；巴巴多斯元的货币代码
entries.en: The price list quotes all amounts in BBD.
entries.zh: 这张价目表的所有金额均以巴巴多斯元列出。

entries.meaningZh: 归属感；有所归属的感觉
entries.en: The weekly choir gave him a sense of belonging.
entries.zh: 每周的合唱团活动让他有了归属感。

entries.en: Benchmarking helped the team compare its delivery times with those of similar firms.
entries.zh: 基准比较帮助团队将自己的交货时间与同类公司进行对比。

entries.en: The book's binding was worn, but none of the pages were missing.
entries.zh: 这本书的封皮已磨损，但书页一张也没少。

entries.en: A bird of prey circled above the field.
entries.zh: 一只猛禽在田野上空盘旋。

entries.meaningZh: 流血（bleed的过去式或过去分词）
entries.en: His finger bled after he caught it on a sharp edge.
entries.zh: 他的手指被锋利的边缘划到后流了血。

entries.en: A blow-up of the photograph revealed a figure in the doorway.
entries.zh: 照片的放大图显出了门口的一个人影。

entries.en: We left the built-up area and followed the road into open countryside.
entries.zh: 我们离开了建筑密集的城区，沿路来到开阔的乡间。

entries.en: Button up your coat before you go outside.
entries.zh: 出去前把外套的纽扣扣好。

entries.meaningZh: 听众或观众打电话参与的节目
entries.en: She raised the issue on a local radio call-in.
entries.zh: 她在当地广播的热线节目中提出了这个问题。

entries.meaningZh: 基本方位；东、南、西、北四方位之一
entries.en: North is one of the four cardinal points.
entries.zh: 北是四个基本方位之一。

entries.meaningZh: 拦牛栅；道路上使车辆可过而牲畜难以通过的栅格
entries.en: The car rattled as it crossed the cattle grid.
entries.zh: 汽车驶过拦牛栅时发出了咯咯声。

entries.en: The diagram labels the clamper separately from the amplifier.
entries.zh: 图中将钳位电路与放大器分别标出。

entries.en: The prefix co- in co-author indicates shared authorship.
entries.zh: co-author中的前缀co-表示共同创作。

entries.en: The historian examined the decision to collectivise the farms.
entries.zh: 历史学者研究了将农场集体化的决定。

entries.en: The prefix counter- helps counterargument express an argument against another claim.
entries.zh: 前缀counter-使counterargument表示针对另一主张提出的反对论据。

entries.en: A layer of cushioning protected the vase inside the box.
entries.zh: 盒内的一层缓冲材料保护了花瓶。

entries.meaningZh: 明目张胆的敲竹杠；贵得离谱的收费（英式非正式用语）
entries.en: Ten pounds for a cup of tea? That's daylight robbery!
entries.zh: 一杯茶要十英镑？这简直是明抢！

entries.meaningZh: 最终离婚判令（传统法律术语）
entries.en: In the novel, she keeps the decree absolute with her other personal papers.
entries.zh: 小说中，她把最终离婚判令与其他私人文件放在一起。

entries.meaningZh: dibs；优先占用权或先选权（非正式用语）
entries.en: I called dibs on the window seat.
entries.zh: 我先声明要靠窗的座位。

entries.meaningZh: 使人严重丧失活动能力的；致残的
entries.en: A disabling injury kept him out of the entire season.
entries.zh: 一处严重影响活动能力的伤势使他缺席了整个赛季。

entries.meaningZh: 双连赛；同日连续举行的两场比赛
entries.en: The rain delay turned Saturday's schedule into a double-header.
entries.zh: 雨天延赛使周六的赛程变成了双连赛。

entries.en: The rainwater drained off the roof into a barrel.
entries.zh: 雨水从屋顶流入了一只桶中。

entries.en: The drumming grew louder as the parade approached.
entries.zh: 随着游行队伍走近，鼓声越来越响。

entries.en: We did a dummy run of the presentation to check the timing.
entries.zh: 我们预演了一遍演示，以检查时间安排。

entries.meaningZh: eco-；表示生态或环境相关的
entries.en: The prefix eco- gives ecotourism its connection with environmental concerns.
entries.zh: 前缀eco-使ecotourism带有与环境议题相关的含义。

entries.meaningZh: en-；使处于某种状态；使成为；围入等
entries.en: The prefix en- in encircle conveys the idea of surrounding something.
entries.zh: encircle中的前缀en-传达了把某物围起来的意思。

entries.en: You can reach the reception desk on ext. 204.
entries.zh: 你可以拨204分机联系前台。

entries.meaningZh: 与……发生冲突；触犯；招致……的不满
entries.en: The proposal fell foul of the committee's rules on spending.
entries.zh: 这项提案违反了委员会关于开支的规定。

entries.en: The bottle's capacity is printed in fl. oz. on the label.
entries.zh: 标签上用液量盎司标出了瓶子的容量。

entries.meaningZh: 拜托；看在老天爷份上（表示不耐烦或强调）
entries.en: I'm only five minutes late, for goodness' sake!
entries.zh: 拜托，我才迟到了五分钟！

entries.en: The prefix geo- links geothermal with heat from the earth.
entries.zh: 前缀geo-使geothermal表示与地热有关。

entries.en: Please go on with your story while I make the tea.
entries.zh: 我沏茶的时候，请继续讲你的故事。

entries.en: The novel follows a journalist investigating a suspected gun-runner.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述一名记者调查一名涉嫌走私军火的人。

entries.en: The library's policy excludes hard porn from its collection.
entries.zh: 这家图书馆的馆藏政策排除露骨色情作品。

entries.meaningZh: 时好时坏的；不可靠的；碰运气的
entries.en: The cafe's service is rather hit or miss on weekends.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆周末的服务相当不稳定。

entries.meaningZh: il-；不；非（in-用于某些l开头词前的形式）
entries.en: The prefix il- turns legal into illegal.
entries.zh: 前缀il-使legal变为illegal，表示“不合法的”。

entries.en: She left early in the belief that the roads would be busy.
entries.zh: 她认为路上会很堵，所以提前出发了。

entries.en: The frame measures 8 in. across.
entries.zh: 这个相框的宽度为8英寸。

entries.meaningZh: 保险理赔员；保险核损员
entries.en: The insurance adjuster photographed the damage to the roof.
entries.zh: 保险理赔员拍下了屋顶受损的情况。

entries.meaningZh: ir-；不；非（in-用于某些r开头词前的形式）
entries.en: The prefix ir- gives irregular the meaning not regular.
entries.zh: 前缀ir-使irregular表示“不规则的”。

entries.en: The investigation uncovered years of systematic law-breaking.
entries.zh: 调查揭露了多年有组织的违法行为。

entries.meaningZh: 少于；不到（数量比较表达）
entries.en: The entire repair took less than an hour.
entries.zh: 整个修理过程花了不到一个小时。

entries.en: The revised timetable is based on feedback from the students.
entries.zh: 调整后的时间表以学生的反馈为依据。
